rules.description: Bridge root is not an object.
Bridge root contains one or more unknown fields.
Required bridge profile is missing or not the v1 profile.
Signature is missing, non-string, or rejected by base64url decoding. This does not claim all schema-invalid encodings are rejected.
Authorization is missing or not an object. Canonical signing material is non-applicable.
Authorization contains one or more unknown fields.
Authorization object lacks one or more required fields.
`authorization_id` is empty or not a string.
`authorizer` is empty or not a string.
Signed `authorizer_key_id` is empty or not a string.

The broad post-decode signal: tamper, wrong trusted key, malformed JWK, invalid decoded signature length, or authorization-preimage canonicalization failure. These causes cannot be separated by the reference result, and the name does not imply Ed25519 verification necessarily began.
A cryptographically valid authorization names a key ID absent from or unequal to the trusted JWK's `kid`.
`authorized_at` has an invalid runtime type or is negative; type/boolean/negative subcases stay grouped.
`expires_at` has an invalid runtime type or is negative; type/boolean/negative subcases stay grouped.
Supplied verification time is not a non-negative runtime integer.
Verification time is before `authorized_at`.
`expires_at <= authorized_at`, after the not-yet-valid check has passed.
Verification time is at or after `expires_at` for a correctly ordered window.
Signed scope is missing or not an object.
Signed scope contains one or more unknown fields.
Tools value is missing, wrong-type, empty, or contains a non-string/empty item. Empty-list and empty-item cases intentionally share this code.
Tools list contains duplicates.
Impacts value is missing, wrong-type, empty, or contains a non-string/empty item. Empty-list and empty-item cases intentionally share this code.
Impacts list contains duplicates.
Runtime tool call is not an object.
Runtime declaration is not an object.
Signed PIC block is missing or not an object.
Signed PIC block contains one or more unknown fields.
PIC profile is missing or not `PIC-CJSON/1.0`.
Signed or PIC-verifier-supplied intent digest has invalid SHA-256 syntax. Provenance remains visible in the separate bridge-schema/input assertions.
Signed or PIC-verifier-supplied args digest has invalid SHA-256 syntax. Provenance remains visible in the separate bridge-schema/input assertions.
Declaration or tool call cannot be canonicalized by RFC 8785. The raw reference exception does not identify which object failed, so the locations stay grouped.
Signed declaration digest has invalid SHA-256 syntax.
Signed tool-call digest has invalid SHA-256 syntax.
Signed `transcript_required` is not boolean.
Signed decision is anything other than exact `allow`. Schema-valid `deny` and a schema-invalid unknown verb intentionally share the runtime code while retaining different bridge-schema assertions.
Runtime tool name is missing from signed `scope.tools`.
Declaration impact is missing from signed `scope.impacts`.
Valid PIC intent digests differ.
Valid PIC args digests differ.
Computed declaration digest differs from the valid signed digest.
Computed tool-call digest differs from the valid signed digest.
Transcript is absent, not an object, or does not contain exactly `before` and `after`.
`before` is invalid or its tool call differs from the runtime call.
`after` is not an object. No result members beyond object shape are invented.
